description.value: Panago is a Canadian pizza chain franchise in Tsawwassen offering delivery and takeout. The chain emphasizes Canadian-sourced ingredients including 100% Canadian wheat dough made fresh in-house, organic tomato sauce, and meats raised without antibiotics. Touring cyclists will find a range of pizzas, salads, and plant-based options available for quick pickup.

The website (panago.ca) is the corporate site for the chain, not a location-specific page, confirming the brand and menu but providing no location-specific details on bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill. Vegetarian/vegan options are confirmed by the website's explicit 'abundant veggie, dairy-free and meat-free choices' language; takeout is confirmed by both the OSM takeaway=yes tag and the website's online ordering/delivery focus.
